headline: Vatican Plans Massive Solar Farm to Power City State
meta_description: The Vatican is building a 424-hectare solar farm near Rome to provide all electricity for the city state, marking a major shift toward renewable energy.
summary_short: The Vatican is constructing a solar farm nearly 10 times its own size to power the entire city state with clean energy.
body:
The Vatican is building a 424-hectare solar farm near Rome designed to provide all of the city state's electricity, marking an ambitious shift toward renewable energy at the heart of the Catholic Church.

The scale of the project underscores its ambition: the solar installation will be nearly 10 times larger than Vatican City itself. By generating enough power to meet the entire city state's electrical needs, the initiative positions the Vatican as a leader in sustainable practices among the world's smallest nations and oldest institutions.

This move reflects broader commitments by religious and civic leaders worldwide to transition away from fossil fuels. For a place known for its tradition and history, the decision to embrace solar technology signals that environmental stewardship now ranks among the Vatican's institutional priorities.
quick_facts: Farm is nearly 10 times the size of Vatican City
Intended to power entire Vatican City state with electricity
Project represents major renewable energy commitment
